description_excerpt: Job Description We have many opportunities for C/C++ Developers to work on a product for one of the world’s leading system providers. You will be working with common components used by several applications in a core network solution. The job is to develop and maintain the security and authentication related services of the cluster platform which is used all over the world. Key job responsibilities: • Collaborate with colleagues in Australia and other countries. • Understand the requirement, design, and implement new features. • Troubleshoot issues, suggest, and implement solutions. •…
